description: This file handles web form submissions for capturing people as leads or contacts in the SuiteCRM environment, specifically related to campaign tracking and email opt-in management. It verifies module validity, processes submitted data, updates related entities like campaign logs and email addresses, manages opt-in/out preferences, and handles redirect responses.

classes.name: SuiteValidator
classes.description: A utility class used for validating IDs, imported from SuiteCRM\Utility namespace.

classes.name: Campaign
classes.description: Represents the Campaign entity, used for retrieving campaign data.

classes.name: EmailMarketing
classes.description: Used to handle marketing specific queries related to campaigns.

classes.name: Person
classes.description: Represents the lead or contact, with properties and methods for data handling.

classes.name: CampaignLog
classes.description: Tracks interactions between campaigns and persons.

classes.name: SugarEmailAddress
classes.description: Handles email address operations such as add/update and opt-in/out.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: Manages system configuration, especially related to email opt-in confirmation.

methods.name: filterFieldsFromBeans
methods.description: Filters form fields from bean objects.

methods.name: encodeMultienumValue
methods.description: Encodes array values for multi-enum fields.

methods.name: isWebToLeadAllowedRedirectHost
methods.description: Checks whether a redirect URL's host is permitted.

methods.name: get_language_header
methods.description: Returns language header info based on current language settings.
